prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Bundesagentur für Arbeit Verzeichnis der Verleiherbetriebe as holding a valid permit under the AÜG?
prompts.why_it_matters: Lending staff without a valid AÜG permit is unlawful, so the register shows whether the company may legally supply temporary workers.

source.name: Bundesagentur für Arbeit - Verzeichnis der Verleiherbetriebe (AÜG)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the AÜG Verleiherverzeichnis published via the Arbeitsagentur and scan the listed licensed firms for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the Verleiherverzeichnis with an active permit entry.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean scan of the register shows no entry under the company name or its location.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register list cannot be opened, or the name is too generic to match a single licensed firm.

prompts.question: Does this company have a profile or quality seal with client reviews on Ausgezeichnet.org?
prompts.why_it_matters: The portal shows whether customers publicly rate the company and whether its seal of quality is authentic.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Ausgezeichnet.org business search and enter the company name together with its city.
prompts.found_when: A profile for the company appears with a seal status or customer ratings.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no profile for the company under a clean name and city search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page is unreadable, or the name matches too many unrelated businesses to identify one profile.

prompts.question: Is this company or its named lawyer listed in the Bundesweites Amtliches Anwaltsverzeichnis (BRAK) as admitted to practise?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only lawyers and law corporations entered in the BRAK register are legally admitted to provide legal services in Germany.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the BRAK bravsearch register and enter the firm name or the individual lawyer's name.
prompts.found_when: The company or lawyer appears with an admission entry and, where shown, specialist titles and practice address.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search by name returns no admission entry for the firm or lawyer.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search fails, or the name is too common to tell which entry belongs to the company.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Berlin Partner network directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A listing signals that the Berlin economic development agency counts the company among the region's visible businesses.

source.name: Berlin Partner für Wirtschaft und Technologie

prompts.how_to_query: Use the search field on the Berlin Partner network pages and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A network or company entry for the company appears in the Berlin Partner directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory search returns no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search cannot be run, or the name returns only unrelated hits.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member in the bevh Mitgliederliste?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership in the German e-commerce association indicates the company is recognised in the distance-selling sector.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the bevh Mitgliederliste and scan the published member names for the company.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the bevh member list.
prompts.not_found_when: The full member list shows no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member list cannot be loaded, or it is only partly published.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Bitkom Mitgliederliste?
prompts.why_it_matters: Bitkom membership shows the company belongs to the recognised German digital and tech industry network.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Bitkom member list and browse the letter matching the company's initial.
prompts.found_when: The company appears as a member under the matching letter.
prompts.not_found_when: No entry for the company appears in the member list under any letter.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member list pages do not load, or the name is too generic to confirm a match.

prompts.question: Does this company have an official company master profile or listed security on Börse Frankfurt (Deutsche Börse AG)?
prompts.why_it_matters: The exchange profile confirms whether claims about a stock listing, bonds or shareholder structure can be verified.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Börse Frankfurt company and securities pages for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A master profile or listed security for the company appears on the exchange portal.
prompts.not_found_when: No company profile or security is found for the name, indicating the company is not listed there.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The portal search does not respond, or several similarly named issuers make the match uncertain.

prompts.question: Has Börsen-Zeitung reported on this company, for example on its bonds, banking relations or regulatory issues?
prompts.why_it_matters: Coverage in the specialist financial press shows how capital-market journalists view the company's finances and standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Börsen-Zeitung site search or its company search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: One or more articles or company entries mention the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no article or company entry for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is paywalled or unreachable, or hits cannot be opened to confirm the company.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Boersennews Community discussions about its management credibility or share performance?
prompts.why_it_matters: Retail investor threads show how the market publicly perceives the company's management and prospects.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Boersennews search and enter the company name to list community threads and posts.
prompts.found_when: Company pages or forum threads discussing the company appear in the results.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no thread or company page for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The community search is unavailable, or hits are unrelated companies with a similar name.

prompts.question: Is this company or its named tax advisor registered in the Bundessteuerberaterkammer Steuerberaterverzeichnis?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only registered tax advisors and firms may legally offer tax advisory services in Germany.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Steuerberaterverzeichnis search and enter the company or advisor name with its place.
prompts.found_when: The company or advisor appears with a register entry confirming the professional title.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search by name and place returns no register entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search does not return results, or the name is too common to identify one entry.

prompts.question: Has this company published financial statements, capital changes, merger or liquidation notices in the Bundesanzeiger?
prompts.why_it_matters: The Federal Gazette is the statutory record of a company's filed accounts and structural changes, so gaps or warnings matter.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Bundesanzeiger search and enter the company name, then scan the published notices.
prompts.found_when: One or more published notices or filed financial statements name the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no publication for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search interface fails, or many similarly named entities make the correct company unclear.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Bundeskartellamt decisions, merger control proceedings or the Wettbewerbsregister?
prompts.why_it_matters: Cartel office records reveal antitrust cases, merger reviews and public procurement exclusions against the company.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Bundeskartellamt decision database for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A decision, proceeding or register entry naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the decision database returns no case involving the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The database search does not run, or the name is too generic to attribute a case.

prompts.question: Is this company entered in a Bundesnetzagentur provider register, such as the Post Anbieterverzeichnis?
prompts.why_it_matters: Providers of postal, telecom or energy services need a register entry, so absence points to an unlicensed operation.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the relevant Bundesnetzagentur Anbieterverzeichnis for the sector and scan the list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the applicable provider register with its licence or registration data.
prompts.not_found_when: The applicable register list contains no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: It is unclear which register applies, or the list cannot be opened or filtered by name.

prompts.question: Has Gründerszene (Business Insider) published a profile, funding report or critical story about this company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Startup press coverage shows whether funding, founders and setbacks reported by the company have been independently checked.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the site search on the Gründerszene section and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: One or more articles about the company are found.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no article about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is blocked or paywalled, or hits cannot be opened to confirm the company.

prompts.question: Does this company have a member profile in the BVMW network directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A BVMW profile shows the company is connected to Germany's main SME business association.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the BVMW member pages for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member profile page for the company exists on the BVMW site.
prompts.not_found_when: No member profile is found for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search is unavailable, or only partial member data is published.

prompts.question: Does Creditreform hold a business report on this company showing a credit rating or payment default warning?
prompts.why_it_matters: Credit agency data flags payment behaviour and default risk that the company itself may not disclose.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Creditreform site search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A company record or report offer for the company is returned, with rating information where visible.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no company record for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Only a paid report would confirm details, or the name is too common to isolate the company.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the DAkkS database as an accredited testing laboratory, certification body or inspection body?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only DAkkS-accredited bodies may issue recognised test reports and certificates, so unlisted claims of accreditation are misleading.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the DAkkS database of accredited bodies and search for the company name.
prompts.found_when: An accreditation entry for the company appears with its scope and validity.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no accreditation entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The database search fails, or the company name matches only unrelated accredited bodies.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Das Örtliche with a matching address and phone number?
prompts.why_it_matters: Directory entries confirm whether the company's stated address and phone number match a real local presence.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the Das Örtliche search and compare the listed address and phone with the company's own details.
prompts.found_when: A listing for the company appears with an address or phone number that matches the company's stated details.
prompts.not_found_when: No listing appears for the company name in the relevant location.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Multiple unrelated entries appear, or the directory cannot be searched for that location.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Deutsche Startups startup directory (Startups A-Z)?
prompts.why_it_matters: The directory shows whether the company is recognised as a startup and gives an independent view of its funding and founders.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Startups A-Z list on Deutsche Startups and scan the entries for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A directory entry for the company appears with its profile data.
prompts.not_found_when: The A-Z list contains no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The list is incomplete or will not load, or the name is too generic to confirm an entry.

prompts.question: Is this company or its site registered in the EMAS-Register Deutschland as validated under EMAS?
prompts.why_it_matters: The public register verifies whether a claim of audited environmental management is actually registered.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the EMAS register search and enter the company name in the company field.
prompts.found_when: A register entry for the organisation or site appears with its EMAS registration number.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no EMAS entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search does not respond, or the company name matches several sites ambiguously.

prompts.question: Does this company publish ad-hoc releases, directors' dealings or voting rights notices on EQS News (DGAP)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Mandatory disclosures reveal insider transactions and events the company might otherwise not publicise.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the EQS News company search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A company page or disclosure list for the company appears.
prompts.not_found_when: No company entry or disclosure is found for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is unavailable, or the name returns only unrelated issuers.

prompts.question: Does this company have a company profile on Experteer Deutschland showing senior or executive vacancies?
prompts.why_it_matters: Executive job profiles indicate whether the company is actively hiring at board or senior management level.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Experteer for the company name and open any matching company profile.
prompts.found_when: A company profile with senior or executive positions appears.
prompts.not_found_when: No company profile is found for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile is behind a login, or the name matches several unrelated employers.

prompts.question: Does this company appear on Freelancermap as a client, and do contractors review its payment reliability?
prompts.why_it_matters: Contractor feedback shows whether freelancers report the company as a reliable, prompt payer.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Freelancermap company search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A company profile appears, with contractor reviews or ratings where available.
prompts.not_found_when: No company profile is found for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company search fails, or the company has no review content to read.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Gelbe Seiten with matching branch addresses and contact details?
prompts.why_it_matters: Yellow Pages entries confirm the operating sector, branch locations and contact data the company claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Gelbe Seiten for the company name nationwide and compare the listed branches and contacts.
prompts.found_when: One or more entries for the company appear with addresses and phone numbers.
prompts.not_found_when: No entry appears for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Many similarly named entries appear, or the directory cannot be searched nationwide.

prompts.question: Has Handelsblatt reported on this company, for example on litigation, management scandals or its financial results?
prompts.why_it_matters: Coverage in Germany's leading business daily shows whether serious journalists have examined the company's conduct and numbers.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Handelsblatt search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: One or more articles naming the company are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no article about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is paywalled or blocked, or hits cannot be opened to confirm the company.

prompts.question: Does this company have a Jobware company profile with current specialist or management vacancies?
prompts.why_it_matters: The profile shows the company's recruitment priorities and whether it is expanding its teams.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Jobware for the company name and open any company profile.
prompts.found_when: A company profile page with vacancies appears.
prompts.not_found_when: No company profile or vacancy is found for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is unavailable, or the name matches several unrelated employers.

prompts.question: Is this company listed on Munich Startup as part of the Munich or Bavarian startup ecosystem?
prompts.why_it_matters: The portal shows whether the company is recognised locally and gives independent detail on its funding and founders.
prompts.how_to_query: Browse the Munich Startup startup listings and scan for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A startup entry for the company appears on the portal.
prompts.not_found_when: The listings contain no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The listings are only partly published or will not load, or the name is too generic to confirm.

prompts.question: Does North Data hold commercial register data on this company, including legal form, managing directors and parent or subsidiary links?
prompts.why_it_matters: Register data exposes ownership chains and director changes that contradict or confirm what the company presents.
prompts.how_to_query: Search North Data for the company name and open the matching company page.
prompts.found_when: A company page appears with register filings, officers or ownership links.
prompts.not_found_when: No company page is found for the name in the German register data.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Several similarly named companies appear and cannot be told apart.

prompts.question: Does Onvista list this company with corporate fundamentals or bond issuer data?
prompts.why_it_matters: Financial portal data allows a check of stated market values, bonds and key figures against an independent source.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Onvista instrument search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A company or bond entry appears with fundamentals data.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no instrument for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns several similar instruments and the company cannot be identified.

prompts.question: Does this company have a ProvenExpert profile with a client satisfaction score and reviews?
prompts.why_it_matters: Aggregated client scores show whether customers publicly vouch for the company's service quality.
prompts.how_to_query: Search ProvenExpert for the company name and open any matching profile.
prompts.found_when: A profile with ratings or reviews appears for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: No profile is found for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile exists but has no ratings yet, or the name matches several unrelated providers.

prompts.question: Does this company appear on Shopvote with merchant ratings and a verified legal web store check?
prompts.why_it_matters: Merchant ratings and legal checks show whether the online shop is independently verified and how buyers rate it.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Shopvote search and enter the shop domain or the company name.
prompts.found_when: A merchant entry appears with ratings or a completed legal verification.
prompts.not_found_when: No merchant entry is found for the shop or company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search cannot be run, or several shops use similar names and cannot be distinguished.

prompts.question: Is this company registered in the Stiftung EAR Herstellerverzeichnis with a WEEE registration number for its brands?
prompts.why_it_matters: Selling electrical equipment in Germany requires an EAR registration, so absence points to a compliance gap.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the EAR Herstellerverzeichnis search and enter the company or brand name.
prompts.found_when: A manufacturer entry with a WEEE registration number appears for the company or its brand.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no manufacturer or brand entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search fails, or the brand name is too generic to match one entry.

prompts.question: Is this company's online shop certified by Trusted Shops and does it carry verified buyer reviews?
prompts.why_it_matters: Certification and buyer reviews show whether delivery reliability and dispute handling have been independently audited.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Trusted Shops shop search and enter the shop domain or company name.
prompts.found_when: A certified shop entry appears with a valid seal and reviews.
prompts.not_found_when: No certified shop is found for the domain or company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The shop search is unavailable, or the seal status cannot be verified on the site.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member company of the Verband der Chemischen Industrie (VCI)?
prompts.why_it_matters: VCI membership shows the company is recognised within the German chemical and pharmaceutical industry.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the VCI member company lists and browse the letter matching the company's initial.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the VCI member company list.
prompts.not_found_when: No entry for the company appears in the member lists.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member pages do not load, or only part of the membership is published.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the VDA member list (unsere Mitglieder)?
prompts.why_it_matters: VDA membership shows the company is recognised among German automotive manufacturers and suppliers.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the VDA member pages and scan the member group lists for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in a VDA member group list.
prompts.not_found_when: No VDA member list contains the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member pages cannot be opened, or it is unclear which member group applies.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the VDMA member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: VDMA membership shows the company belongs to the recognised German mechanical engineering association.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the VDMA member search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member entry for the company appears in the VDMA directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search returns no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search does not respond, or the name returns only unrelated members.

prompts.question: Does this company have discussion threads on the Wallstreet:Online Community about its management, debt or restructuring?
prompts.why_it_matters: Investor forum threads surface public doubts about solvency and management that formal filings may not show.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Wallstreet:Online search and enter the company name to list threads.
prompts.found_when: One or more threads or company pages discuss the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no thread for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is unavailable, or hits refer to other companies with a similar name.

prompts.question: Is this company or its named auditor registered in the Wirtschaftsprüferkammer Berufsregister (WPK)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only auditors and auditing firms in the WPK register may lawfully sign audit opinions in Germany.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the WPK Berufsregister search and enter the firm name, auditor name or register number.
prompts.found_when: A register entry for the firm or auditor appears with an active licence.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search by name returns no Berufsregister entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search fails, or the name is too common to identify a single entry.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the ZVEI member list (Our Members)?
prompts.why_it_matters: ZVEI membership shows the company is recognised within the German electrical and digital industry association.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the ZVEI Our Members list and filter by the company's initial letter.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the ZVEI member list.
prompts.not_found_when: No entry for the company appears in the member list.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member list cannot be loaded or filtered, or the name is too generic to confirm.
